assumptions: The code construction and distance measure chosen (DNABarcodes, or FREE divergence codes for indels).
limits: What it corrects is a property of the code, not a measured error rate on an instrument.
The heuristic constructions do not claim the largest possible set.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which index set of this size has a guaranteed minimum distance, and what does it actually correct?

description: Design a set of NGS sample-index barcodes with a guaranteed minimum distance, and report what that set actually corrects — substitutions, or indels too (DNABarcodes).

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

filter_gc.description: keep only balanced-GC barcodes (suppressed for length ≤ 3). Advanced.

filter_self_complementary.description: reject barcodes that are their own reverse complement. Advanced.

filter_triplets.description: reject barcodes containing a homotriplet (AAA…). Advanced.

heuristic.description: set-construction strategy. Values: conway (Conway (greedy)), clique (Clique), sampling (Sampling), ashlock (Ashlock).

iterations.description: random restarts of the Conway closure (sampling) or generations of the evolutionary search (ashlock); DNABarcodes' default. Only applies when heuristic is sampling or ashlock.

length.description: barcode length in bases. In bp.

metric.description: error model. A set correcting one substitution may correct zero indels, so this choice is the design, not a display option. Values: hamming (Hamming (substitutions)), seqlev (Sequence-Levenshtein (indels)), levenshtein (Levenshtein), phaseshift (Phaseshift).

min_distance.description: required minimum distance between any two barcodes — this is what buys the error correction.

population.description: chromosomes carried per Ashlock generation; DNABarcodes' default. Only applies when heuristic is ashlock.

seed.description: PRNG seed for a stochastic search: the same seed always gives the same set. Only applies when heuristic is sampling or ashlock.

name: design_barcodes

analysis.description: the set's properties under EVERY metric, not just the design one

count.description: how many barcodes the search actually found

guarantee.description: correctable / detectable errors under the design metric

warnings.description: what the search had to say
